semantic_votes.rationale: The absolute term is scoped to the finite Core non-bypassable list and preserves safety controls even at the minimum execution level.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract levels[L1] and non_bypassable; condition: L1 changes process depth, not safety, authorization, or evidence duties.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Fail closed on any unresolved authority or safety boundary and raise the computed level through the closed trigger registry.

semantic_votes.rationale: Explicit-only limits who may request L5; the surrounding obligations preserve non-bypassables and avoid silently expanding formal-release scope.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract levels[L5], validation_loop.formal_scope_rule, and non_bypassable; condition: L5 is explicitly requested for the declared scope.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Apply trigger-derived floors and non-bypassables independently; when formal readiness is declared, require the separate formal evidence gate.

semantic_votes.rationale: The fixed limit bounds repeated validation within one material, scope, level, and path identity; changed material and declared gaps use explicit transitions.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract validation_loop complete_path_limit=1; condition: the limit applies to one complete identity scope, not unrelated changed material or scope.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Block completed-identity reruns; authorize another path only through current bound gap, material-transition, or external-state evidence, and treat new claims as scope change.

semantic_votes.rationale: The absolute wording enforces dispatch-only separation: Main routes on declared or analysis-derived evidence while source reading remains delegated to analysis agents.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract main_evidence_kinds plus the Main dispatch-only authority; condition: Main computes routing level without inspecting target source.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Delegate source inspection to analysis-agent; a plausible critical unknown raises the floor to L4 and blocks editing until resolved.

semantic_votes.rationale: All is bounded to the closed L2 eligibility registry; requiring proof for every predicate prevents low-level routing when any safety boundary is unknown.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract l2_eligibility and formula.l2_requirement=all_true; condition: L2 is considered only for a reversible bounded execution.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Treat any false or unknown predicate as L2 rejection and continue with trigger floors and the default level calculation.

semantic_votes.rationale: All is explicitly limited to specialized gates whose triggers apply, so L4 strengthens high-risk work without loading unrelated gates.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract levels[L4] and closed trigger_registry; condition: each specialized gate is required only when its corresponding trigger applies.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Record trigger evidence and load every applicable high-risk gate; unresolved plausible critical boundaries keep editing blocked at L4.

semantic_votes.rationale: The prohibition protects Core as the single level authority; the router consumes effective level only for Skill selection and cannot diverge.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract projection and formula; condition: the router is a generated projection and not an independent level decision owner.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Validate the router block against the exact Core rendering and reject any added, omitted, or independently maintained level matrix.

semantic_votes.rationale: The mandatory inheritance and strict lowering proof prevent relabeling or material churn from erasing historical risk while permitting genuine narrower child scopes.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract scope_lineage; condition: history is keyed by Task ID and Scope Lineage and lowering is allowed only for a proven narrower child task.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Reject same-task relabeling or lowering, make expansions inherit historical maxima, and require a new Task ID, child lineage, and canonical narrowing proof.

semantic_votes.rationale: The L3 floor is conditional on a named external or unresolved consumer boundary, with a concrete anti-trigger and evidence source.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract trigger_registry external-integration-or-unknown-consumer; condition: external integration or unresolved consumer impact is supported by Task Contract or analysis evidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Evaluate both positive and anti-trigger evidence; if the unresolved consumer is plausibly critical, apply the separate L4 unknown-critical boundary and block editing.

semantic_votes.rationale: Every applies only to the finite L2 eligibility set and makes missing evidence fail closed instead of understating execution risk.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract formula.l2_requirement=all_true and the eight-entry l2_eligibility registry; condition: eligibility is assessed from canonical evidence rows.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Reject L2 whenever any predicate is false or unknown; still aggregate closed trigger floors and prior historical maxima.

semantic_votes.rationale: The mechanism is a deliberate control-plane boundary: Main uses user or analysis evidence for routing and never substitutes its own source inspection.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract main_evidence_kinds and Main dispatch-only rule; condition: target-source facts must arrive through a bounded analysis handoff.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Delegate target-source reading to analysis-agent and treat any plausible unresolved critical boundary as L4 with editing blocked.

semantic_votes.rationale: The numeric limit bounds retry loops for one complete identity while the surrounding contract provides explicit evidence-bound paths for legitimate change.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core execution_level_contract validation_loop complete_path_limit=1; condition: identity includes material tree, declared scope, effective level, and canonical validation path.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Block identical reruns; require a current predeclared gap or verified material or external transition for another path, and treat new claims as scope change.

semantic_votes.rationale: One primary Skill establishes a single accountable professional owner while Layer 3 additions and a separate Review Skill cover specialized concerns.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Professional Skill Router route-once contract; condition: the fixed count applies per bounded task, after its ownership and scope are established.
semantic_votes.mitigation: When responsibility spans multiple owners, analyze and split the work into owned DAG tasks; retain specialized Layer 3 gates and independent review.

semantic_votes.rationale: The mechanism supplies the actual diff without allowing an auxiliary export to mutate or pollute the shared workspace, preserving review independence.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Main diff_input_mode supplied-artifact contract; condition: a missing actual diff is exported by task-agent in diff-export/no-edit mode as content or a host-native artifact.
semantic_votes.mitigation: If the no-edit export or workspace-change evidence is unavailable or changed, mark diff scope unverified and block review closure.

semantic_votes.rationale: This requirement is scoped to an explicit formal-readiness claim and prevents lower execution levels or scope narrowing from bypassing formal evidence.

semantic_votes.mitigation: Raise the formal-release trigger to L4 and keep completion blocked or partial until current formal evidence satisfies the declared release gate.

semantic_votes.rationale: Fresh validation and re-review are conditioned on a material repair edit, correctly invalidating evidence that describes the superseded implementation diff.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Main review-evidence and closure contracts; condition: a repair materially changes the previously validated and reviewed implementation surface.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Mark prior validation and review evidence superseded, then allow closure only after targeted post-edit validation and current independent review of every changed file.
